axes.tier: Architectural risk and reversibility. 1 = cosmetic or behavioral, patchable anytime. 2 = a contained system needing engineering. 3 = architectural, touches how the world stores state.
axes.cost: Art and engineering hours. Deliberately separate from tier, because 12.6 and 13.6 are cases where the two diverge sharply.
axes.deployment: Where it can ship on a running game, per 11.7. live = no new logic, no load at scale, nothing to exploit. ptr = needs a public test realm first. fresh = changes how gold or materials flow and cannot be introduced fairly mid-realm.
axes.ptrReason: Why a PTR is required, per 11.7. load | exploit | stale-knowledge | taste.
axes.layer: Dependency ordering per 11.5. 1 = the world in motion. 2 = the world reacting. 3 = the world circulating. 4 = the world on a clock.
axes.change: Per 11.4. additive = puts something new in the world, invalidates nothing a player knows. revisionary = alters something already known, expensive in player trust rather than engineering.

proposals.title: NPC idle behavior and work animations
proposals.note: A logging camp where nobody logs is the clearest gap. You should be able to learn what a camp is by looking at it rather than by reading a quest.

proposals.title: City density with shift and daily routines
proposals.note: Not risky by design, risky by volume. Thousands of entities at peak population is the thing no amount of reasoning substitutes for watching.

proposals.title: Hidden lore NPCs in hard-to-reach locations
proposals.note: The Cenarion researcher on the Un'goro plateaus. 7.7 makes them the author of the anatomy flavor text, so players carry their work before ever finding them.

proposals.title: Stormwind Park district and idle Stonemasons
proposals.note: Unfinished stonework and tools left where a crew walked off. A player who has run the Deadmines and then notices the Park assembles the connection unaided.

proposals.title: Cart and caravan routes
proposals.note: Load-bearing. Rideable, escortable, robbable, or simply watched. Ships as visible traffic first and as supply consequence later, per 11.8.

proposals.title: Observational-only traffic, ships and zeppelin sightlines
proposals.note: The cheap half of the cart argument. Establishes the visual language on live realms at no risk while the consequential version waits for a fresh realm.

proposals.title: Caravan robbery and reputation consequences
proposals.note: Venture wagons are free-fire. Steamwheedle wagons cost four-city auction access, inverting the Bloodsail and Booty Bay relationship the game already has.

proposals.title: Route ruleset inheritance by zone
proposals.note: Ironforge to Menethil stays safe until Dun Algaz, matching the fiction the Algaz Gate already asserts. Wagon kills carry no honor or credit.

proposals.title: Route funneling through existing chokepoints
proposals.note: Costs nothing because the chokepoints already exist. Purely a routing decision, and it turns evenly distributed scenery into geography with stakes.

proposals.title: Trade network stock movement
proposals.note: Steamwheedle against Venture as the engine. The rivalry is already in vanilla; this makes it visible as freight rather than as quest text.

proposals.title: Steamwheedle cities as supply-dependent
proposals.note: The fiction basis for the entire Tier 3 cart investment. Everlook physically cannot produce what Everlook sells. The map has been saying so since 2004.

proposals.title: Creature pack behavior and stalking
proposals.note: Six wolves evenly spaced like furniture is the baseline being replaced. One eats first, the rest squabble.

proposals.title: Creature rest and sleep cycles
proposals.note: The daily clock. Section 10 runs the same machinery on a yearly one and 4.8 runs it on weather, so this is the shared foundation for all three.

proposals.title: Concealment vegetation art pass
proposals.note: Ambush behavior is worthless without vegetation dense enough to hide in. The art dependency has to land first or the behavior reads as a bug.

proposals.title: Species-specific behavior animation
proposals.note: Devilsaurs holding ground other predators visibly avoid, so danger is readable before you walk into it.

proposals.title: Predator threats to caravans
proposals.note: Where ecology meets the trade network. Needs harder tuning on PvE realms per 2.7.

proposals.title: Creatures reacting to corpses
proposals.note: The delay is the whole thing. Thirty seconds to two minutes, so the common case is that you already left. Attention accrues where players die and decays when they stop, so it can never be farmed.

proposals.title: Kodo Graveyard permanent scavenger presence
proposals.note: Static rather than accumulating, since deaths here are the premise rather than the exception. Puts one working ecology inside an arrested zone, which makes Desolace read as more wrong, not less.

proposals.title: Visible corruption gradient, furbolg and gnoll
proposals.note: Carried by faction tags today, could be carried by the models. Least affected at the edges, worst near the cauldron.

proposals.title: Corruption runners on canonical routes
proposals.note: Put the Winterfall runners on the route the vanilla quest text already describes, so transmission is watchable rather than stated.

proposals.title: Weather-conditional creature behavior
proposals.note: Weather is the third clock and already exists in the client as decoration, which makes it the cheapest of the three to hang behavior on.

proposals.title: Weather-conditional spawns
proposals.note: Lashers in the rain. The template for the whole area because nothing is taken away on a clear day.

proposals.title: Middle-tier humanoid camp behavior
proposals.note: Quilboar defend ground, gnolls raid it. That distinction should be legible without reading a quest.

proposals.title: Quilboar as horticulturalists with grown camps
proposals.note: Agamaggan's blood, not his quills. The Razorfen is what the soil did afterward, which is why tending rather than building is the right read. No cut ends anywhere in the structure.

proposals.title: Responsive Razorfen thorn growth
proposals.note: A plant that behaves like a creature. Thickens where tended, recedes where quilboar have been driven off, which is a readout of who holds the ground with no text at all.

proposals.title: Unscripted faction flare-ups
proposals.note: Hidden triggers and no visible timers. Hidden conditions get datamined and farmed, which is the specific reason this needs a live population to falsify the tuning.

proposals.title: Flare-up quest integrity rules
proposals.note: Named NPCs never become casualties, losses capped as a fraction of a camp, respawn accelerates, and no flare-up fires on a camp with players in combat.

proposals.title: Blackrock war readable from surface activity
proposals.note: One hidden state: who holds more of the mountain. The surface is the only readout. Weather, not a world event, so no timer and no raid dependency.

proposals.title: Cyclical world state as the default model
proposals.note: The architectural answer. A game with continuous new players cannot ratchet, so subtractive change must cycle. Also the reason phasing is rejected: shared reference is most of what the word world is doing.

proposals.title: One-way additive events, Lakeshire bridge
proposals.note: AQ's real lesson is not that permanent change is for max level, it is that permanent change must be additive. A finished bridge takes nothing from anyone who arrives later.

proposals.title: Player action with server-wide temporary effect
proposals.note: The Onyxia head model. Player action, server-wide visible effect, temporary, repeatable. Strictly better than a private phase where the accomplishment is invisible to everyone whose opinion of it matters.

proposals.title: Conditional threats for outgrown zones
proposals.note: Absent at the levels a zone is built for, present for anyone who returns. A conditional spawn rather than a state system, so it costs almost nothing.

proposals.title: Coin removal from beasts
proposals.note: Wolves do not carry silver. The flavor case is easy; the income case in 7.3 is what makes it fresh-realm.

proposals.title: Coin rebalance as income repricing
proposals.note: Genuine change to leveling income, so it cannot be introduced fairly to players with established positions.

proposals.title: Swallowed remains and rare story loot
proposals.note: Rates deliberately negligible and nothing is removed, which is why this ships to live. Flavor should match how each thing feeds: oozes corrode, birds collect, spiders store, wolves gnaw.

proposals.title: Reagent legibility and behavioral tells for internal anatomy
proposals.note: If it envenoms you it has a sac. Technically small and socially expensive, because it relocates drop sources players have had memorized for twenty years.

proposals.title: Naturalist voice across anatomy item flavor text
proposals.note: The cheapest proposal in the document. One author's field notes across dozens of items, so the notes stop where their fieldwork did.

proposals.title: Jewelcrafting
proposals.note: New profession.

proposals.title: Inscription
proposals.note: New profession.

proposals.title: Woodcutting
proposals.note: More interesting once the world already agrees timber is worth fighting over, which Warsong Gulch proves it does.

proposals.title: Regional cooking recipes
proposals.note: Ties recipes to where their ingredients actually come from.

proposals.title: Trapping
proposals.note: New profession, and one that depends on creature behavior being legible first.

proposals.title: Relic hunting
proposals.note: New profession.

proposals.title: Cross-tier material requirements
proposals.note: An anti-death mechanism for low-level zones. Makes low-level goods matter at sixty, which is the same job seasons do on a schedule.

proposals.title: Cross-profession dependencies
proposals.note: A reason for two people to talk, which is most of why vanilla felt populated.

proposals.title: Craftable vendor trade goods
proposals.note: Anti-Venom is the cleanest test case.

proposals.title: Wandering profession trainers
proposals.note: Anchored to the vanilla leatherworking specialists who already live in wilderness camps.

proposals.title: Guard hint system for locating trainers
proposals.note: Returns a region and a staleness, never coordinates. Weighted rather than looped routes so the pattern resists datamining.

proposals.title: Kobold density predicts ore density
proposals.note: The client already demonstrates the correlation everywhere. Making it causal gives mining a reading skill no tooltip explains.

proposals.title: Anti-Venom loop, poison tuning and sac distribution
proposals.note: The counter is found on the threat. Also fixes an old faction imbalance, since reliable sac sources skew Alliance-side.

proposals.title: Vendor restock economy
proposals.note: Vendor stock becoming variable is revisionary by definition, which is where additive delivery stops being sufficient.

proposals.title: Wagon delivery crediting vendor stock
proposals.note: The actual argument for building carts. Open question: the NPC-to-player supply ratio, which 3.5 argues should be per-city rather than one global number.

proposals.title: Westfall supply interdiction
proposals.note: Canonically a supply interdiction plot. Onyxia used her position as Prestor to cut off support and keep the Defias enraged.

proposals.title: Seasonal calendar by latitude and moisture
proposals.note: Two dials, not one. Latitude gives temperature and a per-zone moisture value decides whether a warm zone is jungle or sand.

proposals.title: Full seasonal turn, temperate belt
proposals.note: The Hinterlands against the Plaguelands border is the sharpest visual argument available: living forest turning on one side of a line, dead ground doing nothing on the other, same week.

proposals.title: Muted seasonal pulse for climate statics
proposals.note: Dun Morogh never greens. It still breathes. This tier is what makes the arrested zones legible as anomalies rather than as a category.

proposals.title: Arrested zones, three kinds
proposals.note: Residue, active, and held. Moonglade is the only member of the third category, arrested into life rather than out of it, and it costs nothing because it means doing nothing.

proposals.title: Winterspring multi-year thaw event
proposals.note: Warcraft III put the valley in a rare snowless spring, which is explicit permission. Once every several in-game years, unpredictable from a calendar addon.

proposals.title: Felwood localized healing exception
proposals.note: A faint pulse around the Emerald Sanctuary only. An effort that is working in a small radius and losing everywhere else, which is what the quest text already says.

proposals.title: Per-species herb calendars and migration
proposals.note: Nothing leaves the world, it migrates. Further away and costlier is a different thing from unavailable, and it makes the tropics the shelf-stable pantry.

proposals.title: Seasonal beast density
proposals.note: Never to zero. A winter Elwynn has fewer wolves, not no wolves.

proposals.title: Quest requirements scaling with seasonal density
proposals.note: Counts are visible and move under accepted quests. Kill counters scale proportionally so progress is never lost; item counts never rise, because objects already in a bag cannot be retroactively added to.

proposals.title: Quest text audit for hardcoded numerals
proposals.note: Write thin the pack, never slay ten of them. The one part of Section 10 that is revisionary rather than additive.

proposals.title: Seasonal price movement and demand
proposals.note: A reason for prices to move that is not player behavior, which nothing else in the document provides.

proposals.title: Seasonal visual pass, cosmetic only
proposals.note: The separable half. Lighting, weather, and audio with no gameplay hooks attached, which is what allows seasons to ship in two stages.

proposals.title: Seasonal year snapped to the vanilla holiday calendar
proposals.note: The Lunar Festival is held in the one zone that never has winter. Already in the game, and nobody had to write it.

proposals.title: Weather-conditional gathering windows
proposals.note: Weather changes what is available, never what a player is capable of. May gate a bonus, may not gate a prerequisite, because a cooldown is planning and weather is waiting.

proposals.title: Variety-over-fidelity art stance
proposals.note: Same texture resolution, same polygon budget, more distinct assets. Retail's problem was never polygon count, it is that expensive art gets reused.

proposals.title: Settlement differentiation by material, climate, threat, and age
proposals.note: The first proposal where risk tier and cost diverge sharply. Tier 1 by reversibility, closer to Tier 3 by hours. Infinitely incremental, one town at a time.

proposals.title: Material sourcing made visible on the map
proposals.note: When a zone's poverty is the point, the source must be external. Westfall's timber crosses the Duskwood bridge, so Sentinel Hill is built from a cursed forest because that is what it can afford.

proposals.title: Contestable material sources
proposals.note: A quarry or logging camp is a place that can be pressured, which gives flare-ups a target with consequences traceable to a settlement.

proposals.title: Shared architectural grammar per race
proposals.note: Shared vocabulary, different sentences. The limit: vary what a building is made of, not what it obviously does.

proposals.title: Inward zone additions through existing doors
proposals.note: Karazhan was cut from vanilla for time and Deadwind Pass has almost no content of its own. The four Emerald Dream portals from patch 1.8 already exist, guarded, and lead nowhere.

proposals.title: Non-leveling reason required per new zone
proposals.note: Vanilla ran the experiment already. Un'goro, Winterspring, Silithus, and the Eastern Plaguelands never die because each has a reason that is not leveling. One is usually enough, none is fatal.
